title: Computed style exposes a broad property set and critical interaction properties
description: Calls CSS.getComputedStyleForNode through each raw-capable driver, requires at least 100 distinct properties, and verifies display, visibility, opacity, and pointer-events remain readable.

driver_skips.chrome_devtools_mcp: the pinned MCP tool list has no arbitrary raw-CDP command or CSS.getComputedStyleForNode tool
driver_skips.agent_browser: the agent-browser CLI exposes selected computed observations but no raw CSS.getComputedStyleForNode property list
driver_skips.selenium: the engine-native WebDriver route has no cross-engine raw CSS-domain command and deliberately avoids Chromium-only execute_cdp_cmd
